acceptanceCovered: no code path can put an agent into a chat or UI mode — AgentViewMode has one variant, mode_from_name defaults to Terminal, and the 9 chat-era actions that reached the deleted surface are gone along with their 36 keybindings

the ACP stack the chat depended on is gone from the workspace — reviewer independently grepped every surviving file for acp_thread/agent_servers/acp_tools/agent_settings and found no reference; Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock carry none either
file and folder icons come from the Material Icon Theme in colour — IconSource::EmbeddedColor routes embedded SVGs through img(), verified by 3 tests in crates/ui/src/components/icon.rs

no user-facing control can change the icon theme — the selector modal, its action, its app-menu entry, the extensions-UI prompt and the whole Settings UI icon-theme section plus its picker component are all removed; ThemeRegistry::get_icon_theme ignores the name, asserted directly by get_icon_theme_ignores_the_name_argument
file name matching is case-insensitive so Dockerfile and README.MD resolve — icon_key_for lowercases once, covered by 5 tests in a crate that previously had none
colour themes remain fully user-changeable — the lock lives in ThemeRegistry rather than in the shared theme_settings resolve path; theme_selector's 1 test and theme's 13 pass
the workspace compiles and every touched suite is green — cargo check --workspace --all-targets exits 0 with 0 warnings, cargo build --bin zode exits 0, and 1600+ tests across 17 crates pass
regressionChecked: zode 56 (includes test_action_namespaces, which caught the assistant2 namespace disappearing with agent::ToggleModelSelector's deprecated alias)
ui 38+39, settings 31, sidebar 20, agent_ui 18, settings_ui 15, theme 13, settings_content 13, file_icons 5, extensions_ui 1, theme_selector 1
saved workspace rows carrying the removed mode = "chat" deserialize to Terminal — covered by any_stored_mode_name_comes_back_as_terminal
removing the icon_theme key from default.json was tried and reverted: it turns 332 tests red because from_settings unwraps unconditionally, so the key stays pinned and inert
test_hibernate_after_ms_zero_disables_hibernation fails under multi-crate load; proven pre-existing by stashing the tree and reproducing the identical failure at HEAD with the same command

findings.summary: Settings UI offered a full icon-theme section, including a free-text theme-name field, that the registry silently ignores

the icon_theme schema enum is built from list_icon_themes(), so a name typed into settings.json is both rejected by the schema and ignored at runtime; removing the UI leaves the single-value enum as the honest description
an extension shipping an icon theme named "Material Icon Theme" would have replaced every file icon with no way to switch back; the name is now reserved on load and undeletable on removal
right-clicking a selection offered "Add to Agent Thread", whose only handler lived in the deleted chat view
15 public types describing the deleted chat and model-provider surface survived a green cargo check because Rust does not dead-code-warn on unused public items
the name-ignoring contract central to the feature had no test of its own; four were added
204 path-qualified associations could never match a lookup that only sees Path::file_name; stripped, and the generator now drops them

icon_key_for allocates a lowercase String per call and get_icon calls it up to five times per file; left as is because the candidate substrings do not all borrow one buffer, so folding them would be a real refactor for short ASCII strings
reported as a checked-in artifact still naming deleted actions; it is gitignored, so not checked in, and it was regenerated via script/generate-action-metadata anyway

set_assistant_enabled has no caller, so the terminal's Inline Assist button and menu entries are unreachable; git grep at HEAD shows it had no caller before this change either, so it is pre-existing and left alone
zode_logo.png (50KB to 310KB) and a new zode_app_icon.png are unrelated to either feature and are deliberately excluded from these commits rather than explained in them
